assessments.mechanism: Use high-information verifier/compiler diagnostics for iterative repair instead of pure independent resampling.
assessments.clean_scope: Goedel-Prover-V2 Lean. MiniF2F pass@32 88.1%→90.4% with two compiler-guided correction rounds; PutnamBench 43→57 solved; extended correction 92.7% pass@32 versus vanilla 92.2% at pass@8192. Long-context repair means pass count is not compute matching.
assessments.uncertainty: Lean-specific and token/wall cost not fully matched.
assessments.o_comparison: O routes failed/uncertain units to fresh Root and retains objective evidence, so generic conditional repair is implemented; no Lean compiler-diagnostic repair/self-correction study exists.

assessments.mechanism: Use structural sample diversification when policy mode collapse is present, but gate it because the same intervention can hurt other training regimes.
assessments.clean_scope: arXiv 2601.16172. DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL MiniF2F k=16 i.i.d. 38/244 vs tactic-skeleton 55/244; +12.3±4.2 theorems across three seeds. On SFT Goedel-Prover intervention is -10.0±4.4.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly values heterogeneous exploration and measured width-3 sibling checkpoints vs width-1 on three frozen tasks; that exact adaptation was rejected only for its own scope. It did not test RL mode-collapse or tactic-skeleton diversity.

assessments.mechanism: Use executable Lean process feedback as dense process-level RL credit assignment concentrated at decision-boundary tokens.
assessments.clean_scope: 2026 theorem-proving RL. STP-Lean MiniF2F supervised pass@32/64 55.9/56.7; outcome+tactic reward 57.1/59.2; first-tactic-token credit 57.1/59.2 versus all tactic tokens 56.3/57.8. ProofNet is mixed.
assessments.uncertainty: Gains are modest/benchmark-dependent and not a general verifier-RL result.
assessments.o_comparison: O has deterministic task evaluation but no token-level RL/process-reward training from executable verifier feedback.

assessments.mechanism: Hierarchically decompose long verified-code proof obligations and use cheap structural rejectors before expensive completion.
assessments.clean_scope: Goedel-Code-Prover 2026. Verina no decomposition+Gemini completion 19.6% vs GPT-5.2-Pro decomposition+Gemini 54.4%, trained decomposer+trained completion 68.8%; matched hierarchical SFT→RL pass@32 66.1→68.8; decomposition score AUROC 0.903. Headline whole-vs-hierarchical comparisons are not compute-matched.
assessments.uncertainty: Formal-proof domain and model/decomposition confounding apply.
assessments.o_comparison: O already decomposes into falsifiable units and uses preflight/protected regression/fail-closed checks before expensive/active changes; no formal-proof decomposition/ranking implementation exists.

assessments.mechanism: Jointly plan implementation and proof obligations before committing, instead of build-then-prove sequentially.
assessments.clean_scope: P^3 2026 Lean verification. Across four frontier backends×three benchmarks, +4.6 to +11.2pp over stronger baseline. Claude Opus controlled planning ablation: Verina 69.8→74.6, AlgoVeri 44.8→48.1, Lean4Commit0 13.9→22.2; difficult-subset API cost up to -39.6% and wall -37.2%. One run/task/model/method cell.
assessments.uncertainty: No within-task variance; transfer to smaller/open models untested.
assessments.o_comparison: No joint program-and-formal-proof planning mechanism matching P^3 exists in O.

assessments.mechanism: Learn a refinement search over compiler failure modes and allocate fixed inference budget adaptively between restart and repair.
assessments.clean_scope: Compile to Compress 2026, budget 64. Goedel base MiniF2F/ProofNet/MOBench/Putnam 84.43/15.63/14.72/32 solved; random refinement 84.43/23.72/30.28/63; value-guided 86.89/24.26/34.44/63. Putnam value 63/82/110 at budgets64/128/256. Cold-start direct 32 vs base-refine46 vs SFT-refine47 vs expert-iteration63 isolates most gain to on-policy repair training.
assessments.uncertainty: Lean-specific; composite structural-diversity+repair remains untested under a single matched budget.
assessments.o_comparison: O already alternates fresh Root/repair-style continuation and uses decision-value selection, but has no compiler-error abstraction, learned restart-vs-repair value function, or fixed-budget Lean refinement tree.

assessments.mechanism: Generate structurally distinct candidate implementations/proofs first, then perform bounded local verifier-guided repair within each branch.
assessments.clean_scope: Diversifying to Verify 2026, Why3/SMT program verification. 73 tasks×4 representations=292 artifacts: 96 initially verify; +35 after repair pass1; +23 after pass2; final154/292 (52.7%). 49/73 tasks have at least one verified variant versus 44/73 for strongest single family. No same-compute four-i.i.d. control.
assessments.uncertainty: Not Lean; representation contracts are not formally proven equivalent; diversity's marginal causal gain is not isolated.
assessments.o_comparison: O has a narrow width-1 vs width-3 sibling-checkpoint experiment plus generic verification/repair primitives, so related branch-width and repair submechanisms are partially tested; no structural-representation composite exists.

assessments.mechanism: Train a dedicated compiler-feedback repair module; narrow repair supervision can outweigh raw model scale on isolated repair.
assessments.clean_scope: APRIL 2026, ~260k synthetic Lean mutation/fix tuples. Single-shot repair: Qwen3-4B baseline1.1%→finetuned27.4%, slightly above Goedel-Prover-V2-32B baseline26.8%; finetuned Goedel-8B34.6%. Evaluation shares the synthetic mutation family with training distribution.
assessments.uncertainty: Natural failed-proof transfer and end-to-end pass@K impact are not established.
assessments.o_comparison: O has no finetuned proof-repair model or compiler-feedback repair-training dataset.

assessments.mechanism: Repository-scale formal reasoning needs selective dependency/context retrieval; dumping the whole repository can reduce verification success.
assessments.clean_scope: VeriSoftBench 2026, 500 Lean obligations/23 repositories, avg68 transitive deps max480. Curated-vs-full context: Gemini-3-Pro41.0% vs34.8%; Claude Opus4.5 31.2 vs23.2; GPT-5.2 12.6 vs10.8; Goedel curated5.6% on496 tasks while full-context0% on context-limited44-task subset. Curated dependencies use ground-truth proof and are oracle/best-case, not deployable retrieval.
assessments.uncertainty: Learned retrieval without ground-truth proof remains unresolved; full context can contain useful analogies in some cases.
assessments.o_comparison: O Context Kernel implements selective optional context and rejects copy-all, with a pending held-out action-adherence comparison; no formal repository dependency selector or VeriSoftBench evaluation exists.
